Our FAIR Act puts an end to SNAP fraud by requiring photo ID on every EBT card and verifying identity before a single dollar is spent.

More than 226,000 fraudulent SNAP benefit claims and more than 691,000 unauthorized transactions were approved across the country last year.

YOU'RE paying for it. We're working to put an end to it.

posts.text:
Registered sex offenders should never under any circumstances have access to children.

Yet right now, nothing in federal law stops them from using surrogacy to get one.

We introduced the Protecting Children in Surrogacy Act to close this loophole once and for all. If you are on the sex offender registry, you cannot obtain a child through surrogacy. Violations carry up to 10 years in federal prison.

Children are not commodities. Predators will not exploit this system on our watch.
